scope: Futures asset contribution reference; public marks with complete signed positions and clearly labelled signed aggregate fallback

equations.live_crossed_unrealized_pnl: sum(signed position quantity * (public markPrice - entryPrice)) for all nonzero crossed positions with the same margin asset
equations.snapshot_fallback: exact asset.crossUnPnl from signed GET /fapi/v3/account when complete linear crossed positions/marks are unavailable; no partial live + old PnL mix
equations.negative_equity: Multiply first, then min. Negative equity uses the more negative ask-side result; do not clamp.
equations.rates: Absolute USD per unit of asset from assetIndex; not percentages, buffers or the valuation index.

mapping: Keep crossUnPnl separately from total unrealizedProfit; absent remains unknown and malformed signed decimal rejects the account snapshot.
Both nonnegative decimal string bidRate/askRate with bid<=ask are required. Invalid optional rates disable contribution but preserve an otherwise valid valuation index.
Require explicit marginAvailable=true; this is multi-asset eligibility, not evidence of current multi-asset mode.
No walletBalance/availableBalance/total UPL/asset peg substitution; missing values never become zero.

Live sum requires every relevant position explicitly crossed, known margin/quote units equal (linear contract), positive entry, valid positive mark. Unknown units/mode prevent partial summation; explicit isolated and zero positions are excluded.
An empty relevant position list preserves signed aggregate rather than assuming zero PnL.
Any applied account event invalidates contribution until a new signed snapshot; ACCOUNT_UPDATE lacks the full crossed aggregate. Complete marks do not override this guard.

public_transport.implementation: Existing MarkPricesRepository; no new HTTP/WebSocket clients in widgets.
public_transport.scope: Stable normalized wallet address plus sorted deduplicated supported account-wide crossed symbols. Visible eligible cards share one autoDispose family subscription; quantity/order changes do not replace it.
public_transport.private_boundary: Uses only supplied already-loaded account models. Never initializes authProvider/accountReadProvider, requests a signature, creates a wallet or sends private/financial API requests.
public_transport.lifecycle: No marks for unvalued modes/units/isolated/zero/ineligible/event-invalidated cards. Last consumer closes transport/timers; pause stops and resume requests public marks; wallet scope changes discard former cached data and late responses.

freshness.account: Existing account stale flag or receipt age >=60s/negative marks value stale.
freshness.rates: Reuse asset index controller:30s polling, receipt60s/source90s/future skew30s; paused or failed data stale.
freshness.marks: Existing repository10s source/receipt freshness per symbol and online connection; disconnected/stale complete marks retain their numerical reference with stale notice, malformed/missing marks use signed fallback.
freshness.timestamps: Expanded calculation shows account receipt, rate source time and oldest used mark time, all explicit UTC.

ui.entry: Futures AsterAccountRows asset card; independent from wallet/margin USD valuation.
ui.localization: 17 new messages per locale, English and Simplified Chinese.
ui.states: Value and live/snapshot source; unknown eligibility/equity/rates, ineligible, account events and stale explanations; expanded equity/rates/formula/time.
ui.precision: Decimal throughout, display with existing marketNumber; no binary floating arithmetic.

nonclaims: Contribution is a reference, not spendable order margin, withdrawal capacity, personal earnings or execution evidence.
No Swap, automatic assetExchange, collateral conversion, active multi-asset setting or full cross-product Portfolio total is implemented by this increment.
Public website source is implementation evidence, not a stable third-party compatibility guarantee.
Automated tests/build do not prove actual private API acceptance, wallet signing, native networking/layout or iOS compilation.
